activity_summary: You said the weaver's going and coming twice, the second time bigger, the way Kemp fills a yard. You said the feet would give you away before you did. You left the bellows-mender's line for the page, and you told yourself to write it and not to count.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke it twice and turned to the clean sheet.

facets.activity: Tried the weaver's lines in a bigger voice

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: He goes off a man. He comes back not.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Write it, and do not count.
